description: Upload one or more local files to the current page. Works with plain file inputs (visible or hidden), custom upload buttons, shadow-DOM inputs (open roots only, one level deep), top-level same-origin iframes, and drag-and-drop zones. For file inputs and upload buttons, uses CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to intercept the OS file picker — a brief debugging banner appears during the upload. For drop zones, dispatches a DataTransfer drag-and-drop event. Paths must be within directories configured in upload_allowed_paths in ~/.poltertab/config.json. Nested iframes (iframe inside iframe) and cross-origin (out-of-process) iframes are not supported and return a clear error.

method.description: 'picker' (default): click the selector and intercept the OS file chooser via CDP — works for any file input or button that opens one. 'drop': dispatch drag-and-drop events with the file bytes — use for drop zones that do not open an OS picker.

paths.description: Absolute paths to local files to upload. Each must be within a directory listed in upload_allowed_paths in ~/.poltertab/config.json.

selector.description: CSS selector for the upload trigger — the visible button, label, or file input itself. For drop zones (method: 'drop'), the selector of the drop target element.

session.description: Named session (tab) to run against; it becomes the current tab. browser_navigate with a new name opens it its own tab, so a loop can keep one tab instead of opening hundreds. Other tools error on a name that does not exist yet.

tabId.description: Act on this tab (an id from browser_tab_list) without making it current. Omit to use this agent's current tab: the last one navigated, opened or switched to. A tabId Chrome does not have returns tab_not_found.

name: browser_upload_file
